response.rationale: Several T1 meta-analyses show metacognitive strategy interventions, prompts and epistemic cognition raise or correlate positively with achievement (small to medium effects, durable at follow-up), and the T6 EEF toolkit entry agrees at about +7 months, but some items are only indirectly about metacognition, the effects are modest, and a few are T3 non-academic studies, so confidence is moderate.
